intelligence.essence: NayaNET is a new internet where wise helpers called Nayas do the work for you, and everyone you meet there helps everyone grow.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a friendly helper who lives in your computer and knows how to do things for you. You just ask her, in your own words, and she builds it, finds it, or explains it. She remembers what you like, she keeps your things private, and she introduces you to people like you. That is Naya, and NayaNET is her world, where everyone has a helper like that.
intelligence.grandma_view: My dear, the world got too complicated, and too many clever people took advantage of that. NayaNET puts the wisdom back first: do no harm, help each other, and share what you earn. It is a place built on kindness and good sense, where the machine serves the person, never the other way round.
intelligence.ai_view: It means you no longer have to learn the machine — the machine learns you. One place holds your world, your work, your friends, your learning, and your earning, all connected, all in plain words.
